title: Cut rc1: tag, build, approve to the test feed

before.body: After PR-1, PR-2 and PR-3 are merged: push tag v6.1.0-rc1, wait for the workflow, then on the Studio run release-approve.sh v6.1.0-rc1 (publishes to appcast-test.xml only). No files change.

body: After PR-1, PR-2 and PR-3 are merged: set VERSION to 6.1.0 and head CHANGELOG's Unreleased section '6.1.0 (release candidate)' in a small PR, then push tag v6.1.0-rc1, wait for the workflow, and on the Studio run release-approve.sh v6.1.0-rc1 (publishes to appcast-test.xml only).
done_when: the v6.1.0-rc1 release has Tether.zip, gh attestation verify passes, and appcast-test.xml lists rc1 with an update-key signature
command: gh release view v6.1.0-rc1 -R jordanromines-jpg/tether && curl -sL https://github.com/jordanromines-jpg/tether/releases/download/appcast/appcast-test.xml | grep -c 'sparkle:edSignature'
